reads_as_reason: Wavy, lumpy sausages with bulges and pinches along each segment and no clear taper; melted or half-sculpted, not a deliberate shell.

G1.evidence: Mid-length pinches and bulges, a bone-like profile; the 130 degree view shows the shank ending in a bulbous knob; organic and cartoonish. P8a/P8b fail.

G2.evidence: Front view: the thigh edge steps in and out a third of the way down and again above the knee; grey silhouette wobbles against the target at the lower shank (T1a 0.9356, T1b 0.9432 fail). Zebra shows ring islands and broken stripes. Knee gap is a plain diagonal cut.

G3.evidence: No colour; the knee gap is too shallow to judge as a recess.

G4.evidence: Section squareness and radii vary within each segment: squarish shoulders then round lobes; large soft lumps next to tight corners.

G6.evidence: No references. Thigh top and knee block resemble the family; the wavy mid-thigh and lumpy shank do not.

pairwise.evidence: The baseline (design-1, Image A) has a smooth continuous tapering thigh and calf, a clean knee bulge in the front silhouette and a near-exact match to the red target. It is plain and slightly pill-like but reads as a finished simple shell. The candidate adds lumpy articulation with no clear taper. Moderate confidence.

Remove the lumpy swell at the shank end; single taper from the widest point to a narrower ankle (P8b 0.807).
